inputs.text: President Abinader is once again showing his misplaced priorities by seeking favor from international bodies instead of defending Dominican sovereignty and the traditional values that have maintained order and stability in our society for generations. On 25 March 2026 in Paris he stood by as Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez signed a Memorandum of Understanding with OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann to launch the Dominican Republic's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. This amounts to handing over more control of our domestic affairs to outside progressive institutions that show little regard for strong national authority, personal responsibility, or the family and faith foundations that actually sustain our culture. We would be far better off depending on our own traditions and leaders rather than inviting this foreign interference.
